subject: [PATCH v3] memcg: keep folio's objcg same as its node

2026-08-08.patch_summary: This patch fixes a problem in the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) implementation where folio migration across nodes breaks the assumption that a folio's objcg is the same as its node. The patch ensures that the objcg of a folio is always updated to match its new node when it is migrated, and also updates the LRU list reparenting logic to be atomic with the objcg reparenting. This fixes a race condition between migration and reparenting where an LRU operation on a folio could take the wrong lock. The patch makes changes to several functions in mm/memcontrol.c to implement this fix.
